layout_strategy.bento_grid: Use mixed col-spans (4, 6, 8, 12) to create asymmetric, interesting layouts. Avoid uniform 3-col grids everywhere.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous padding (py-12, py-24) to let the glass effect breathe.

visual_enhancers.orbs: Use absolute positioned divs with heavy blur (blur-3xl) and opacity-20 to create ambient background lighting that matches the selected industry color.
visual_enhancers.mesh: Overlay a subtle noise texture (opacity-5) on the background to prevent banding.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'tracing beam' effects or gradient borders on active cards.

motion.counters: Use framer-motion useSpring for animated number counting.

images.logo_placeholder: Use a simple typographic logo 'SALES.OS' in Sora font.
images.industry_icons: Use Lucide React icons for industry representation (e.g., Home for Roofing, Stethoscope/Sparkles for MedSpa).
images.backgrounds: Do NOT use photographic backgrounds. Use CSS-generated gradients and mesh effects.

structure.nav: Fixed bottom or floating top bar. Glassmorphic. Tabs: Industry, Discovery, Command, Workflow, ROI, Case Studies, Trial.

pages.industry_selector: Hero section + Grid of 10 cards. Roofing & MedSpa highlighted.
pages.discovery: Split view: Left = Input Sliders (Glass), Right = Live Impact Preview (Big Animated Numbers).
pages.command_center: Dashboard layout. Map view (optional), Agent Activity Feed, Pipeline Funnel.
pages.workflow: Compare Slider (React-Compare-Image style) or Side-by-Side cards showing 'Old Way' vs 'New Way'.
pages.roi_calculator: Deep dive charts (Area/Bar) showing cumulative growth. Interactive toggles.
pages.case_studies: Masonry or Grid of success stories with 'Verified' badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Create a 'Layout' component that handles the dynamic background (orbs changing color based on industry).
3. Build the 'GlassCard' primitive component first and use it everywhere.
4. State Management: Use a simple React Context to hold 'selectedIndustry' and 'discoveryMetrics'. All tabs need access to this.
5. MOCK DATA: Create a robust 'industryData.js' config file. Do not hardcode text in components. Map over this data.
6. Charts: Custom style Recharts to match the dark theme (hide grid lines, use gradients for fills).
7. Font installation: Add Sora and IBM Plex Mono via Google Fonts in index.css.
8. Keyboard shortcuts: Implement a listener for keys 1-7 (tabs), P (presentation), F (fullscreen).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for dark colors.
Create depth with z-index and glassmorphism.
